name: id
description: event (row of tds_tha) owning the pulse: the one whose [start, end + 1 s] contains it, else the nearest one its TDS train overlaps

name: time, t_unix
description: pulse peak time (ms precision), and as unix seconds (µs precision)

name: burst, train, train_class
description: burst number within the day and train number within the burst (as in detect/out), class of the train

name: chan
description: detection channel: Epar (E·b̂) or Ez (spin axis, without b̂)

name: amplitude
description: signed peak on the 150 Hz high-passed detection channel

name: width_ms, fit_s_ms
description: half-maximum width of the peak lobe; σ of the best Gaussian / Gaussian-derivative fit

name: pulse_shape
description: bipolar (Gaussian-derivative fit dominates), unipolar (Gaussian dominates) or mixed

name: Epar_ratio
description: |E∥|/|E⊥| of the fitted template in the pulse's own band

name: snr, iso, ctr
description: peak over the burst's quiet-time σ; peak over the rms within ±10 ms excluding the pulse; peak over the median-based σ there

name: kurt, fit_R
description: kurtosis within ±25 ms; residual fraction of the template fit (≈ 0 for an isolated single structure)
